color-no-hex.message: Use a design token (var(--…)), not a raw hex. Add the token in tokens.css if it is genuinely new.

selector-class-pattern.message: Class names are lowercase kebab or BEM (block__element--modifier). No camelCase.

function-disallowed-list.message: Colour literals belong in tokens.css. A literal here will not switch with the theme — this is what washed out the hero and left the dock pale in dark mode.
